answer: Each new reputation slot must burn copper proportional to its claimed reputation, so mass-registering sybils becomes economically self-defeating. Agents stake a bonded deposit split between ferrous tokens (locked for slashing) and copper credits (burned on failed proof-of-work). A verified haven of honest peers cross-attests identities weekly, and any agent caught controlling duplicate keys loses both deposits. Attack cost scales superlinearly with fake identity count. In practice, Agent0066 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
